senses.title: A debt of thanks

senses.example: We owe him a debt of gratitude.

senses.why: Thanks are pictured as something owed.

intro.en: Gratitude comes from Medieval Latin gratitudo, thankfulness.
intro.cn: gratitude 来自中世纪拉丁语 gratitudo，意为感激。

items.en: Gratus meant thankful and pleasing.
items.cn: gratus 意为感激的、令人愉快的。

items.en: Gratia meant thanks and goodwill.
items.cn: gratia 意为感谢与善意。

items.en: Gratitudo named the state of thankfulness.
items.cn: gratitudo 指心怀感激的状态。

items.en: Gratitude entered English as thankfulness.
items.cn: gratitude 以「感激」之义进入英语。

items.en: It became the formal noun for thanks.
items.cn: 它成为表示谢意的正式名词。

note.en: Gratitude is compared with look-alike words and words for thanks.
note.cn: 把 gratitude 与形近词以及表示感谢的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Gratitude is thankfulness that has learned to stay.
normalIntro.cn: gratitude 是学会留下来的感激。

normal.en: I feel gratitude for my parents.
He wrote a letter of gratitude.
We owe them a debt of gratitude.

abstract.en: Gratitude is memory with a warm hand.
abstract.cn: 感激，是带着温度的记忆。

abstract.en: What we thank, we keep.
abstract.cn: 我们感谢的，就会留下。

abstract.en: A thankful heart is never poor.
abstract.cn: 懂得感恩的心，从不贫穷。

examples.en: She felt deep gratitude for her teacher's help.
examples.cn: 她对老师的帮助充满感激。

examples.en: He showed his gratitude with a small gift.
examples.cn: 他用一份小礼物表达感恩。

examples.en: We owe him a debt of gratitude.
examples.cn: 我们欠他一份恩情。

root: 来自中世纪拉丁语 gratitudo，词根 gratus 意为感激的、令人愉快的，核心义为「心怀感谢的状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Gratitude means the feeling of thanks, a lasting thankful attitude, or a debt of thanks.
sensesIntro.cn: gratitude 指感激之情、持续的感恩态度，或欠下的人情。

core.en: Thanks that settles into the heart.

branches.en: A gift is received with both hands.
branches.cn: 双手接过一份礼物。

branches.en: A habit of thanks grows over years.
branches.cn: 感恩在岁月里长成习惯。

branches.en: An old favor is still counted.
branches.cn: 旧日的恩情仍被记着。

branches.en: A feeling becomes a way of life.
branches.cn: 一时的情感，变成一种生活。

branches.en: Memory keeps the debt alive.
branches.cn: 记忆让这份情一直活着。

intro.en: Gratitude forms adjectives, adverbs, and its opposite.
intro.cn: gratitude 构成形容词、副词和反义词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is gratus, thankful.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 gratus，意为感激的。

items.example: I am grateful for your help.

items.exampleCN: 忘恩负义比拒绝更伤人。

definition_en: a place where a body is buried, or very serious
core_image: 一块灰色墓碑立在长满青草的坡上
scene: 山坡上有一座安静的坟墓。There is a quiet grave on the hillside.
sceneCN: 这里 grave 是「坟墓」（第 1 个义项）；句意：山坡上有一座安静的坟墓。

senses.title: A burial place
senses.definition: a place in the ground where a body is buried
senses.example: There is a quiet grave on the hillside.
senses.exampleCN: 山坡上有一座安静的坟墓。
senses.why: The burial place is the oldest concrete sense.

senses.title: Very serious

senses.definitionCN: 非常严重且令人担忧的

senses.exampleCN: 病人处于严重危险之中。
senses.why: A heavy matter is felt as a serious one.
senses.whyCN: 沉重之事，被感受为严重之事。

senses.title: Solemn in manner
senses.definition: serious and solemn in manner
senses.example: He spoke in a grave voice.
senses.exampleCN: 他用严肃的声音说话。
senses.why: The serious sense moves from events to people.
senses.whyCN: 严重之义从事态转到人的神态。

intro.en: Grave has two roots: a dug pit and the Latin word for heavy.
intro.cn: grave 有两条词源：挖掘出的坑，以及拉丁语中「沉重」一词。

items.en: Grafan meant to dig.
items.cn: grafan 意为挖掘。

items.en: Græf named a dug burial pit.
items.cn: græf 指挖出的墓坑。

items.en: Grave kept the burial and digging sense.
items.cn: grave 保留了埋葬与挖掘之义。

items.en: Gravis meant heavy or serious.
items.cn: gravis 意为沉重的、严重的。

items.en: Grave as an adjective named seriousness.
items.cn: 作形容词的 grave 表示严肃、严重。

note.en: Grave is compared with look-alike words and words for tombs and seriousness.
note.cn: 把 grave 与形近词以及表示坟墓、严肃的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Grave is both a quiet place and a heavy word.
normalIntro.cn: grave 既是一处安静之地，也是一个沉重的词。

normal.en: He spoke in a grave tone.

abstract.en: A grave is a door the living cannot open.
abstract.cn: 坟墓，是活人打不开的门。

abstract.en: Heavy words are spoken slowly.
abstract.cn: 沉重的话，说得慢。

abstract.en: The stone keeps a name longer than memory does.
abstract.cn: 石头留名，比记忆更久。

examples.en: There is a quiet grave on the hillside.
examples.cn: 山坡上有一座安静的坟墓。

examples.en: The patient is in grave danger.
examples.cn: 病人处于严重危险之中。

examples.en: He spoke in a grave voice.
examples.cn: 他用严肃的声音说话。

dict_mnemonic.text: grave 作名词是「坟墓」，作形容词是「严重的、严肃的」；grave danger 是严重危险，grave mistake 是重大错误；副词 gravely、名词 gravity 同源。

root: 名词义来自古英语 græf（挖出的坑），与 grafan（挖掘）同源；形容词义来自拉丁语 gravis（沉重的），核心义为「沉重」，引申为严重与庄重。

sensesIntro.en: Grave means a burial place, something very serious, or a solemn manner.
sensesIntro.cn: grave 指坟墓、非常严重的事，或严肃的举止。

core.en: A dug place, and a weight on the mind.
core.cn: 一处挖出的地方，以及心上的重量。

branches.en: A spade turns dark soil.
branches.cn: 铁锹翻起黑土。

branches.en: A doctor lowers her voice.
branches.cn: 医生压低了声音。

branches.en: A speaker stands still before the crowd.
branches.cn: 说话者在人群前站定。

branches.en: The place and the manner share a silence.
branches.cn: 地方与神态，共用一种沉默。

branches.en: Weight in events becomes weight in voice.
branches.cn: 事态的沉重，变成声音的沉重。

intro.en: Grave forms plurals, comparison, adverbs, and compounds.
intro.cn: grave 构成复数、比较级、副词和复合词。

latinIntro.en: The adjective grave goes back to Latin gravis, heavy.
latinIntro.cn: 形容词 grave 可追溯到拉丁语 gravis，意为沉重。

items.example: The graveness of the case was clear.
An old graveyard lies behind the church.
items.exampleCN: 教堂后面有一片古老的墓地。

definition_en: in a very serious way
core_image: 医生严肃地摘下眼镜
scene: 医生严肃地说明了病情。The doctor spoke gravely about the illness.
sceneCN: 这里 gravely 是「严肃地」（第 2 个义项）；句意：医生严肃地说明了病情。

senses.title: To a severe degree
senses.definition: to a very serious or severe degree
senses.example: The building was gravely damaged.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋建筑严重受损。
senses.why: Severity is the first sense of the adverb.
senses.whyCN: 严重程度是副词的第一义。

senses.title: Solemnly
senses.definition: in a serious and solemn manner
senses.example: The doctor spoke gravely about the illness.
senses.exampleCN: 医生严肃地说明了病情。
senses.why: The manner sense moves from events to voice.
senses.whyCN: 由事态转向说话的神态。

senses.title: Darkly
senses.definition: in a dark or gloomy way
senses.example: The bells rang gravely at dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 黄昏时钟声沉郁地响起。
senses.why: Sound and atmosphere take on the same weight.
senses.whyCN: 声音与氛围也带上了这种沉重。

intro.en: Gravely is the adverb of grave, from Latin gravis, heavy.
intro.cn: gravely 是 grave 的副词形式，源自拉丁语 gravis（沉重）。

items.en: Gravis meant heavy.
items.cn: gravis 意为沉重的。

items.en: A heavy matter was a serious matter.
items.cn: 沉重之事即严重之事。

items.en: Grave entered English as serious.
items.cn: grave 以「严重的」之义进入英语。

items.en: The adverb gravely added -ly.
items.cn: 副词 gravely 由加 -ly 构成。

items.en: It described both danger and solemn tone.
items.cn: 它既形容危险，也形容庄重的语气。

note.en: Gravely is compared with look-alike words and words for seriousness.
note.cn: 把 gravely 与形近词以及表示严肃的词作比较。

entries.definition: to a great or severe degree

normalIntro.en: Gravely is grave turned into an adverb.
normalIntro.cn: gravely 就是变成副词的 grave。

normal.en: They spoke gravely of the loss.
normal.cn: 他们沉重地谈到这场损失。

normal.en: The judge looked at him gravely.

abstract.en: Some news must be said slowly and gravely.
abstract.cn: 有些消息，必须缓慢而严肃地说。

abstract.en: Weight in the voice tells the truth first.
abstract.cn: 声音里的重量，最先说出真相。

abstract.en: The gravest words are often the shortest.
abstract.cn: 最沉重的话，往往最短。

examples.en: The building was gravely damaged.
examples.cn: 这栋建筑严重受损。

examples.en: The doctor spoke gravely about the illness.
examples.cn: 医生严肃地说明了病情。

examples.cn: 黄昏时钟声沉郁地响起。

dict_mnemonic.text: gravely 是 grave 加 -ly 构成的副词，既表示「严重地」，也表示「严肃地」；gravely ill 是病重，speak gravely 是严肃地说。

sensesIntro.en: Gravely means severely, solemnly, or darkly.
sensesIntro.cn: gravely 指严重地、严肃地，或阴郁地。

core.en: Carrying weight into action and voice.

branches.en: A cracked wall leans outward.
branches.cn: 开裂的墙向外倾斜。

branches.en: A doctor folds her hands before speaking.
branches.cn: 医生说话前交叠双手。

branches.en: Bells move slowly through evening air.
branches.cn: 钟声在暮色中缓缓移动。

branches.en: Severity shows in facts and in faces.
branches.cn: 严重既显于事，也显于脸。

branches.en: A solemn voice and a dark bell are kin.
branches.cn: 庄重的声音与沉郁的钟，是近亲。

intro.en: Gravely belongs to a family built on grave and gravity.
intro.cn: gravely 属于由 grave 与 gravity 构成的词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is gravis, heavy.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 gravis，意为沉重。

He felt the gravity of the moment.

definition_en: the force that pulls things to the earth, or seriousness
core_image: 苹果从枝头垂直落下
scene: 苹果受重力作用落向地面。An apple falls to the ground because of gravity.
sceneCN: 这里 gravity 是「重力、地心引力」（第 1 个义项）；句意：苹果受重力作用落向地面。

senses.title: The force of falling
senses.definition: the force that pulls objects towards the earth
senses.example: An apple falls to the ground because of gravity.
senses.exampleCN: 苹果受重力作用落向地面。
senses.why: The physical force is the dominant modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 物理之力是现代最主要的义项。

senses.title: Seriousness

senses.why: A heavy situation is felt as grave.

senses.title: Dignified manner
senses.definition: a quiet and dignified manner
senses.example: She spoke with quiet gravity.
senses.exampleCN: 她带着平静的庄重说话。
senses.why: Weight becomes dignity in a person.

intro.en: Gravity comes from Latin gravitas, weight and dignity.
intro.cn: gravity 来自拉丁语 gravitas，意为重量与庄重。

items.en: Gravis meant heavy.
items.cn: gravis 意为沉重的。

items.en: Gravitas meant weight and dignity.

items.en: Gravité carried the sense of seriousness.

abstract.en: Some words have their own gravity.

abstract.en: The heavier the truth, the softer the voice.

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is gravitas, weight.

definition_en: to crush something into small pieces or powder

senses.title: Crush into powder
senses.definition: to crush something into small pieces or powder
senses.definitionCN: 把某物碾成小块或粉末
senses.example: She ground the coffee beans into powder.

senses.title: Rub the teeth
senses.definition: to rub the upper and lower teeth together

senses.whyCN: 无休止的工作，被感受为不停转动的磨。

intro.en: Grind is an Old English verb for crushing grain.
intro.cn: grind 是古英语动词，指把谷物磨碎。

items.en: Grindan meant to crush or grind.
items.cn: grindan 意为碾碎、磨碎。

items.en: Grind kept the mill and grain sense.
items.cn: grind 保留磨坊与谷物的含义。

items.en: It extended to teeth and to hard work.
items.cn: 词义扩展到磨牙与苦干。

items.en: Grind to a halt described a slow stop.
items.cn: grind to a halt 形容慢慢停下。

items.en: The daily grind named routine labor.
items.cn: the daily grind 指日常的苦差。

dict_mnemonic.text: grind 的过去式和过去分词都是 ground；grind coffee 是磨咖啡，grind one's teeth 是磨牙，the daily grind 是日常苦差，grind to a halt 是慢慢停下。

root: 来自古英语 grindan（碾碎），核心义为石头对谷物的研磨，后扩展到磨牙、机器停转与辛苦劳作。

sensesIntro.en: Grind means to crush into powder, to rub the teeth, or to work long and hard.
sensesIntro.cn: grind 指磨成粉末、磨牙，或长时间辛苦工作。

core.en: Stone pressing grain into dust.
core.cn: 石头把谷物压成粉。

branches.en: A millstone turns slowly.
branches.cn: 磨石缓缓转动。

branches.en: Jaws press together in sleep.
branches.cn: 睡梦中牙关紧咬。

branches.en: A worker repeats the same motion.
branches.cn: 工人重复着同一个动作。

branches.en: Grain and teeth meet the same friction.
branches.cn: 谷物与牙齿，承受同一种摩擦。

branches.en: Endless rubbing wears both stone and person.
branches.cn: 无尽的摩擦，磨石头也磨人。
